description: A financial analyst with strictly daytime hours accesses confidential documents at 3 AM on a Sunday. The system authenticates her correctly. VIGÍA must detect that the Firstness (valid login) contradicts the Secondness (temporally impossible context for this user).
analyst_notes: Pure Secondness case according to Peirce. The traditional system says 'correct password, all good'. VIGÍA says 'the temporal context breaks the documented habit of this user'. Originally in Spanish to demonstrate multilingual capability.
